description: Source code for MenuEditor class and related functions in the MenuLibre project, handling menu structure manipulation, icon theme retrieval, and GMenu integration.

classes.name: MenuEditor
classes.description: Class for managing and editing application menus using GMenu, including loading, parsing, and manipulating menu XML and structure.

methods.name: get_icon_theme_name_from_settings
methods.description: Retrieves the current GTK icon theme name from GTK settings.

methods.name: get_icon_theme_name_from_icons
methods.description: Attempts to determine the icon theme name based on icon files in the theme directory.

methods.name: get_icon_theme_name
methods.description: Returns the icon theme name, prioritizing settings, then icon files, then default 'Adwaita'.

methods.name: get_default_menu
methods.description: Returns the filename of the default application menu, checking user and system directories.

methods.name: menu_to_treestore
methods.description: Converts a menu structure into a GTK TreeStore for display.

methods.name: get_treestore
methods.description: Creates and returns a GTK TreeStore representing the current menu structure.

methods.name: get_extended_icons
methods.description: Generates a list of extended icon names, preferring symbolic icons if applicable.

methods.name: get_submenus
methods.description: Recursively retrieves submenus and menu items from a GMenu structure.

methods.name: get_menus
methods.description: Loads and returns the entire menu structure from MenuEditor.

methods.name: removeWhitespaceNodes
methods.description: Removes whitespace-only text nodes from an XML DOM.

methods.name: getUserMenuXml
methods.description: Generates the XML header and structure for a user menu file.
